name: screen-atmosphere
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One standalone wide landscape image for a premium light enterprise industrial safety command dashboard. Airy soft daylight, sophisticated architectural editorial realism, extremely low contrast, almost white atmospheric depth. Composition: vast quiet white space across center and upper 80%, delicate architectural structures ONLY along bottom edge and outer corners. Palette white #ffffff, mist gray #f4f7fa, very pale hints of #1765d1 and #148b98. Gentle natural shadows, calm beautiful material quality, not science fiction.
